title: [AINews] Anthropic successfully completes largest IPO in history, valued at $1.5T
summary:
As we previewed on our Know Before You IPO pod , Anthropic set its IPO price at $83 and today $ANT closed at $97.17, up 17% from the offering price ( drifting -5% to $92.60 after the close) . The $81.3B offering overtook SpaceX's June IPO as the largest in history. 

 Dario and Daniela ( Dario’s remarks , Founders’ letter ) used the occasion to say Anthropic would pace training and deployment based on whether it could keep its systems safe and under human control. 

 Their Class F shares carry 50.1% of voting power on most shareholder matters. Expect the lockup expiries to weigh on the stock price as about a trillion dollars of shares free up over the next year, while Anthropic has to keep the world’s top model ... for now . 

 AI News for 11/18/2026–11/19/2026. We checked 12 subreddits and 544 accounts on X . Search past issues in the AINews archive .

 AI Twitter Recap 
 Anthropic listed on Nasdaq under $ANT, priced at $83, and opened 34% higher, putting it near a $2T valuation. 

 Listing: Anthropic rang the Nasdaq opening bell ( @kimmonismus , @yacinelearning ). The official account posted a media-only launch item that drew by far the day's highest engagement ( @AnthropicAI ). 

 Opening trade: $ANT opened at $111.50 , which is $28.50 (34.3%) above the $83 IPO price ( @TheRundownAI , @kimmonismus ). Pre-open indications were up ~32% at ~$110 ( @kimmonismus ). 

 Record raise: The $81.3B raised beats SpaceX's $75B (June) as the largest IPO ever ( @TheRundownAI ).

title: Token fraud is here and it’s BAD (YouTube)
summary:
Token fraud is here and it’s BAD (YouTube) 

Claire Vo runs ChatPRD , an AI platform that helps product managers "turn an idea into a spec". The product has been live since the GPT-4 era, and Claire has been building it in public for much of that time.

 In this YouTube video (see also the accompanying Twitter post ) Claire describes the flood of token fraud she has seen from groups abusing the product's free trial, sometimes just to get free AI usage but often to resell tokens or run other commercial enterprises on top of the ChatPRD agent.

 I am funding a international Roblox and Fortnite map studio. They run a loop of free trials and promo codes and then tunnel to my agent and use it to build Roblox and Fortnite maps.

 Apparently one of the common prompts Claire saw running through her agent involved SVGs of pelicans riding bicycles! Presumably the token scammers are using that to help sniff the underlying models - different model families have a definite signature, and I've used it like this in the past to try and guess the identity of stealth preview models on platforms like OpenRouter.

 Claire is winding down her free trials entirely, which sadly looks like the right decision in the face of this abuse.

 Tags: youtube , ai , generative-ai , llms , pelican-riding-a-bicycle , ai-misuse

title: Scaling Linear’s GTM to $100M ARR — Cristina Cordova, COO
summary:
Open video on YouTube ↗ 

 Linear was founded to build a better issue tracker. Seven years and $134 million in funding later, its CEO Karri Saarinen published a post titled "Issue tracking is dead." In this episode, we chat with Cristina Cordova , COO of Linear , about how the company navigated that and how its go-to-market changed along the way. 

 Cristina spent seven and a half years at Stripe, led platform and partnerships at Notion, and was a partner at First Round before joining Linear in 2023. Linear's founders built it after living with legacy issue trackers at Coinbase, Airbnb and Uber, and it spread self-serve through startups like Vercel and Ramp. 

 When she joined, Linear had about 40 people and one salesperson. Since then it has shipped an MCP server, a platform for building agents into Linear, integrations with Codex, Cursor and GitHub Copilot, and its own Linear Agent. Agents created 3% of Linear's work a year ago. Now it's more than half. Linear passed $100 million in ARR this year with more than 40,000 paying customers and 177% net revenue retention, and in August employees sold $99 million in stock at a $2.5 billion valuation . 

 We talk about why she stopped chasing enterprise deals three weeks after joining, why Linear has never hired a single SDR, why it won't let an LLM answer support tickets on its own, and what the AI budgets behind $100M-in-months ARR mean for everyone else. 

 Half the work on Linear is now created by agents 
 Linear shipped its MC
